title: 第十五章  丽麂水边
content_zh:
即使真有变故，这个距离对他来说，可以立于不败之地。

    “大侠。”老大点头哈腰地恭维道。

    “你是什么人，半夜三更在这里做什么？”万风良厉声问道。

    “大侠，如你所见，我是一名降妖师。”老大摊开手解释道。

    “降妖师？”万风良一愣，但是他觉得有点耳熟。

    “小人来自西南的戌州，在我们家乡，降妖师专门负责降伏捉拿妖精的职业，就是这种妖怪。”老大指了指旁边的蜈蚣。

    “也就是您这边称呼的山鬼。”又补充道。

    “哦。”万风良好像记得在哪里听说过这事，但是又想不起来，就用元气探查了一下老大，发现并无异样。

    “这么大一只蜈蚣，你们要注意点。”万风良并未过多纠结，继续朝招摇城走去。

    “是是，会注意的，大侠。”老大恭维地说道。

    本来以为糊弄过去，老大长吐一口气，没想到万风良突然停下脚步说道：“等等。”

    然后转过来对着老大，严肃地说道：“这么大一只蜈蚣，你捉到后准备怎么处理。”

    “您看。”老大弓着腰转过身去，用手指着蜈蚣命令到：“小”

    黄光一闪，蜈蚣急速地收缩，变成胳膊粗细，虽然比普通蜈蚣还是大上不少，但是比起刚才来说，已经少了很多。

    看到万风良没反应，老大用手指在空中画了几个圈，会过意的蜈蚣连忙在地上打了几个滚，又反画了几个圈，蜈蚣就反向打了几个滚。

    “您看，在俺们家乡，有种专门表演的地方，这个蜈蚣到时候能卖不少钱。”老大脸上满是献媚的笑容。

    “嗯，不错，训练得不错。”万风良就消失在夜幕中。

    看到万风良消失，老大长吐了一口气，意识到是自己大意了。不过他身为老大，他明白一个道理，就是自己绝对不会错。对着蜈蚣就是一脚，心中的郁闷消去大半。

    蜈蚣被踢了转了几个圈后，赶快散去元气恢复成人的模样。

    斜眼和水蛇腰，静静的站在那里，谁都不敢作声，这种时候谁出声谁倒霉。

    “嘘。”老大长吁一口气，随着暗黑中突然伸出手臂抓出，本来就粗壮的手臂，在元气的作用下，不断变长变粗，只听到一阵阵“咔咔”的声音，等胳膊缩回来时，一只厌火连同他的坐骑被拉了回来，身上的骨头都已经被捏碎，像一摊肉泥。

    “嘘”老大又长吁了一口气，水蛇腰和斜眼也跟着长吁了一口气，他们知道，既然已经杀了人，老大的气已经出完了。就在这时，他们看到不远处的天空上，一阵黄光闪过后，一股磅礴的元气爆发出来。紧接着，两股，三股，四股，五股。

    每一股元气都强大无比，都是他现在无法对抗。

    “我，我这是捅了马蜂窝了？”望着元气发来的方向，他有种逃跑的冲动。

    墨非夜等人顺着丽麂水一番寻找，眼看天就要亮了，还是一无所获。
content_en:
Even if something unexpected happened, this distance would make him invincible.

    "Hero." The boss nodded and bowed in compliment.

    "Who are you and what are you doing here in the middle of the night?" Wan Fengliang asked sharply.

    "Hero, as you can see, I am a demon subduing master." The boss spread his hands and explained.

    "Demon subduing master?" Wan Fengliang was stunned, but he felt it sounded familiar.

    "The villain is from Xuzhou in the southwest. In our hometown, demon subduing masters are responsible for subduing and capturing monsters, this kind of monster." The boss pointed to the centipede next to him.

    "That's what you call mountain ghost here." He added.

    "Oh." Wan Fenghao seemed to remember hearing about this somewhere, but he couldn't remember it, so he used his vitality to check the boss and found nothing strange.

    "You should be careful with such a big centipede." Wan Fengliang did not hesitate too much and continued walking towards Zhaoyao City.

    "Yes, you will pay attention, hero." The boss said flatteringly.

    Originally thinking that he had been fooled, the boss let out a long breath, but unexpectedly Wan Fengliang suddenly stopped and said, "Wait a minute."

    Then he turned to the boss and said seriously: "What are you going to do with such a big centipede after you catch it?"

    "Look." The boss hunched over and turned around, pointed at the centipede and ordered: "Little"

    With a flash of yellow light, the centipede shrank rapidly and became as thick as an arm. Although it was still much larger than an ordinary centipede, it was already much smaller than before.

    Seeing that Wan Fengliang didn't respond, the boss drew a few circles in the air with his finger. The centipede, who was complacent, rolled a few times on the ground. After drawing a few circles in reverse, the centipede rolled a few times in the opposite direction.

    "You see, in our hometown, there is a place that specializes in performances. This centipede can be sold for a lot of money." The boss's face was full of a flattering smile.

    "Well, not bad, the training was good." Wan Fengliang disappeared into the night.

    Seeing Wan Fengliang disappear, the boss let out a long breath and realized that he had been careless. But as the boss, he understands that he can never be wrong. Just kick the centipede, and most of the depression in my heart disappears.

    After being kicked and spun around a few times, the centipede quickly dissipated its energy and returned to its adult appearance.

    With squinting eyes and watery waist, he stood there quietly, no one dared to say anything. Whoever spoke out at this time would be unlucky.

    "Shh." The boss let out a long breath, and suddenly stretched out his arm to grab it from the darkness. The already thick arm continued to grow longer and thicker under the influence of vitality, and only heard bursts of "click" sounds. When the arm was retracted, a Yanhuo and his mount were pulled back, and the bones on his body had been crushed, like a puddle of meat.

    "Shhh" The boss let out another long breath, and Shui Sheyao and Xianyan also let out a long breath. They knew that since they had killed someone, the boss was done with his anger. At this moment, they saw a flash of yellow light in the sky not far away, and a majestic energy burst out. Then, two strands, three strands, four strands, five strands.

    Every energy was extremely powerful, but he couldn't fight it now.

    "I, have I stirred a hornet's nest?" Looking at the direction where the energy came from, he had the urge to run away.

    Mo Feiye and others searched along the Liji River. Seeing that it was almost dawn, they still found nothing.
